profile.headline: Crafting engaging and optimized stories for the digital world. Operations + Strategy | Journalism — Writing + Editing | Content Creation + Production | Social Media Strategy + Management | Data Analytics + Marketing
profile.summary:
At the heart of my work with Local Legend Foundation and Varsity House Podcast lies a passion for melding storytelling with technology. 

As Local Legend Foundation's web developer, I crafted a dynamic online platform that resonates with the foundation's mission to support local youth through sports and community events. My background in Journalism and Biology from the University of Central Florida underpins my approach, merging analytical thinking with creative communication strategies. I love building and advancing my skills in data analytics, measurement frameworks and business intelligence.

My skills span across search engines and social media platforms — specifically, advertising strategy and data measurement & analysis, bolstered by hands-on experience in writing and digital editorial work at Fox News Media. 

The importance of developing and assessing a data strategy to create an effective client journeys and campaigns is a skill I learned through collaboration on an RFP with Brand MACRO. 

These skills enable me to develop digestible audience/customer data frameworks using clear guidelines and transparent processes when it comes to the collection and governing of first-party data and the overall customer journey.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Local Legend Foundation's website — https://www.locallegendfoundation.org/ — from start to now.
• Working alongside the foundation's leadership, I continue to work and update the site to understand the foundation's needs, goals, and updates to optimize and elevate the Local Legend's mission  — to equip children and young adults with the tools to embrace and handle the struggles of life through sports and community events. Local Legend Foundation is a 501(c)(3)public charity and Ohio nonprofit.

positions.title: Writer, Digital Editorial - (Video; Operations & Strategy)
positions.description:
• Work with video and web teams to streamline communications, increase the visibility of all streaming shows on OutKick.com/social platforms achieving the goal of maximizing web traffic.

• Maintained and organized OutKick’s video hosting page (https://video.outkick.com/).

• Spearheaded the implementation of advertisements injected within replay clips on https://video.outkick.com/.  

• Spearheaded the construction, automation, and implementation of a complete and automated Slack and AirTable utilizing FOX's Workspace using OutKick’s workflow to minimize news disruptions.  

• Crafted the workflow for the “featured video” slot in OutKick's website relaunch (the looping video on https://www.outkick.com/). 

• Trained all transitioning employees — and onboarded all new hires (writers, editors, video and production crew) — on workflow and programs (i.e. AirTable, WordPress, Chartbeat, and JW Player). Created guides to communicate best practices on training.

• Tasked with tracking and analyzing OutKick's live stream analytics, social media data, and website analytics for web and video to provide informed impact assessments to senior leadership. Worked with senior leadership to understand and provide best practices.

• Built and maintained all podcast/livestream show landing pages; responsible, in part, for the social media scheduling and copy for all shows to ensure online presence (including podcasts).

positions.title: Editor In Chief
positions.description:
- Managed a team of reporters & produced coverage that was fair and objective. Came up with weekly story budgets, coverage plans, and requested public records. Acting as both EIC. and managing editor.
- Led student reporters through coverage to hold Student Government Association officials, school administrators, and UCF officials accountable.
- Conducted interviews with community leaders & covered topics of interest to the greater Orlando community.
- Reported biweekly to lawyers and advisors on the financial and legal well-being of the organization.
- Solely responsible for all site editing, management, and social media strategy — responsible for Knight News' Instagram growth from just under 4,600 followers at the time of my arrival to over 10,000 at my departure.

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description:
- Oversaw a team of more than 10 reporters. 
- Sent out daily and weekly news budgets —along with breaking news story opportunities to allow student journalists opportunities to write breaking news in a timely manner. 
- Responsible for editing, fact-checking, publishing, and social.
- Researched upcoming news events, and relevant topics of interest to the readership, assigned coverage and monitored web traffic and analytics.
- Planned all KnightNews.com's web, social, and partnership strategies to ensure clear communication and success.

positions.title: Copy Chief, Sports Photographer
positions.description:
As part of UCF's senior capstone class, I was appointed copy chief by the student-led publication's adviser and tasked with copy editing all articles submitted to NSM Today from several journalism classes — approximately 40 students, with varying levels of journalism experience.
- Created a workflow to check that all published articles were clean, correct, and concise. Edited all published work for AP style, spelling and flow.
- Ensured every published story — including cutlines, graphics, headlines, and captions — was grammatically and factually correct. Prioritized teaching opportunities and knowledge to grow, like sending edits back to reporters and communicating as a team.
- Spearheaded the production of a publication-specific AP Style guide and best-practices guide for the content management system.
- Served as the last person in the editing chain to revise all copy before publication.

I also took photos at UCF sporting events during the same time frame.
- Worked alongside NSM Today's sports editor to ensure captivating visuals were included in all sports reporting.
- Worked to create a "stock" of photos the publication could pull from in breaking news or general news coverage stories.

As part of UCF's senior capstone class, I was appointed copy chief by the student-led publication's adviser and tasked with copy editing all articles submitted to NSM Today from several journalism classes — approximately 40 students, with varying levels of journalism experience.
- Created a workflow to check that all published articles were clean, correct, and concise. Edited all published work for AP style, spelling and flow.
- Ensured every published story — including cutlines, graphics, headlines, and captions — was grammatically and factually correct. Prioritized teaching opportunities and knowledge to grow, like sending edits back to reporters and communicating as a team.
- Spearheaded the production of a publication-specific AP Style guide and best-practices guide for the content management system.
- Served as the last person in the editing chain to revise all copy before publication.

I also took photos at UCF sporting events during the same time frame.
- Worked alongside NSM Today's sports editor to ensure captivating visuals were included in all sports reporting.
- Worked to create a "stock" of photos the publication could pull from in breaking news or general news coverage stories.
